## MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the Current Market Regime?
RISK-ON: low volatility 18.5% with broad participation (Breadth 6/8) indicating a strong bull tone and risk appetite.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Construction & REIT and Holding & Investment are leading; Construction & REIT ABOVE TREND: TKFEN (1W: +22.75% | 1M: +31.74%) ABOVE TREND, KCHOL (1W: +5.64% | 1M: +8.65%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Heavy Industry and Retail & Food are lagging with clear weakness; Heavy Industry BELOW TREND: ASELS (1W: -3.14% | 1M: -13.20%) BELOW TREND, Retail & Food BELOW TREND: ULKER (1W: -2.73% | 1M: -12.79%) BELOW TREND.

## STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
TKFEN (1W: +22.75% | 1M: +31.74%) ABOVE TREND, TAVHL (1W: +5.97% | 1M: +3.40%) ABOVE TREND, KCHOL (1W: +5.64% | 1M: +8.65%) ABOVE TREND, TRALT (1W: +5.12% | 1M: -3.48%) RECOVERY, YKBNK (1W: +4.70% | 1M: -9.84%) RECOVERY.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
VESTL (1W: -5.46% | 1M: -8.35%) BELOW TREND, KONTR (1W: -5.18% | 1M: +15.80%) CORRECTION, CCOLA (1W: -4.30% | 1M: +2.51%) CORRECTION, EREGL (1W: -4.29% | 1M: +4.69%) CORRECTION, SOKM (1W: -3.84% | 1M: +10.51%) CORRECTION.

6. Momentum Stocks?
TKFEN (1W: +22.75% | 1M: +31.74%) ABOVE TREND, TAVHL (1W: +5.97% | 1M: +3.40%) ABOVE TREND, KCHOL (1W: +5.64% | 1M: +8.65%) ABOVE TREND, TRALT (1W: +5.12% | 1M: -3.48%) RECOVERY, VAKBN (1W: +4.45% | 1M: -1.44%) RECOVERY.

## SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Banking Sector Outlook?
Banking shows selective recovery with 1W: +1.81% but 1M: -7.83%; AKBNK (1W: +2.66% | 1M: -8.41%) RECOVERY, GARAN (1W: +1.81% | 1M: -2.85%) RECOVERY, ISCTR (1W: -3.74% | 1M: -13.16%) BELOW TREND.

8. Industrial Sector Outlook?
Heavy Industry remains mixed to weak (1W: -1.23%); EREGL (1W: -4.29% | 1M: +4.69%) CORRECTION, FROTO (1W: +3.74% | 1M: -3.94%) RECOVERY, ASELS (1W: -3.14% | 1M: -13.20%) BELOW TREND.

9. Energy & Chemicals Outlook?
Energy is a clear cyclical winner with 1W: +1.38% and pockets of strength; TUPRS (1W: +3.49% | 1M: +22.38%) ABOVE TREND, TRALT (1W: +5.12% | 1M: -3.48%) RECOVERY, GUBRF (1W: +3.86% | 1M: -5.48%) RECOVERY.

## PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Follow the RISK-ON signal: overweight Construction & REIT, Holding and select Energy names; trim lagging Heavy Industry and weak Retail positions while keeping cash/light hedges for idiosyncratic pullbacks.

## NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
Watch TKFEN (1W: +22.75% | 1M: +31.74%) ABOVE TREND for momentum continuation, TUPRS (1W: +3.49% | 1M: +22.38%) ABOVE TREND for energy-driven moves, KCHOL (1W: +5.64% | 1M: +8.65%) ABOVE TREND for holding-led flows, EREGL (1W: -4.29% | 1M: +4.69%) CORRECTION for mean-reversion.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
Monitor Construction & REIT and Energy & Chemicals for leadership, and Banking for confirmation of the recovery theme.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Key triggers: continuation above recent XU100 swing highs to confirm momentum, USD/TRY and energy price moves for TUPRS and TRALT, and bank earnings/asset-quality headlines as the short-term catalyst set.

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
RISK-ON market with low volatility and broad sector participation; momentum concentrated in Construction & REIT, Holding and Energy. Opportunity: overweight cyclicals (TKFEN, TUPRS, KCHOL); risk: sharp mean-reversion in lagging Heavy Industry and Retail names.
